messages:
Hiro Tanaka: Heads-up: launching the Nov benchmark + webinar series. Want to run an APAC-friendly cascade (evening posts) and a short employee-amp push for LinkedIn. Need ops + copy by EOD.
Zoe Martinez: I can do copy. Do we want a long-form LinkedIn post + short tweet thread, or keep the LI post short?
Eli Brooks: Long-form LI with 3 bullets + carousel works best for SEO/engagement. For X, short thread + a pinned data slide. Posting windows: APAC evening (6:30pm JST) and NA morning (10:00am PT next day).
Tara Singh: Targeting: infra PMs, platform engineers, and startup CTOs in APAC & EMEA. I'll prep segmented seedlists and timezone buckets.
Sam Patel: Employee amp plan: one email to staff with prewritten LinkedIn share text + hashtags, and 3 suggested comment replies they can use. Can marketing ops generate the admin link and a pre-fill message?
Hiro Tanaka: Yes. Employee share text should be short & personal. Example: "Proud of the team — we just published a new benchmark & demo on reducing inference cost. Join the webinar: https://redwood.ai/nov-bench"
Zoe Martinez: Draft LI long-form: 
"Production inference is a bottleneck for many teams — and it doesn't have to be. In our new benchmark we compare three practical configs and share code + deployment notes. Join our short webinar for a live walkthrough and Q&A. Register: https://redwood.ai/nov-bench"
Zoe Martinez: X thread draft: 
1) "New benchmark: production configs that reduce per-token cost without sacrificing latency. Live demo + Q&A. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/nov-bench #MLInfra #DevTools"
2) "Snapshot: batching + prefix-cache reduces cost by ~3x in steady traffic profiles (internal)."
3) "Well walk through implementation notes + tradeoffs in the webinar. Seats limited."
Eli Brooks: Ops schedule snippet (use Buffer/Hub):
```
APAC X thread -> 2025-11-12 18:30 JST
APAC LinkedIn long post -> 2025-11-12 18:35 JST
NA X repost -> 2025-11-13 10:00 PT
Employee amp email -> send 2025-11-12 17:45 JST (1hr before publish)
```
Tara Singh: Seedlist links: APAC seed -> https://drive.google.com/seed/novbench_apac.csv; EMEA seed -> https://drive.google.com/seed/novbench-emea.csv. I'll flag high-priority enterprise contacts.
Sam Patel: Employee message drafts uploaded to Drive with prefilled LinkedIn copy and three canned comments. Also added alt-text suggestions for images.
amp-bot: Employee amp scheduled: 2025-11-12 17:45 JST. Template: "Share on LinkedIn" prefill loaded.
Hiro Tanaka: UTMs: utm_source={employee|organic|paid}&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=novbench2025&utm_content={apac|na|emea}. Please ensure creators and employees use the employee UTM when sharing.
Zoe Martinez: Creative ask: hero (1200x628), carousel slide 1 (benchmark chart, 1200x1200), slide 2 (code snippet highlight, 1200x1200). Will upload in 30m.
Eli Brooks: Paid boost plan: $750 total, run for 8 hours staggered across regions. Prioritize APAC initial window to capture evening engagement. Split 60% APAC / 40% NA+EMEA.
Tara Singh: Seedlist handling rules: dedupe against CRM, tag timezone column, and set SDR priority (1/2/3). Clickers -> SDR touch within 12h during working hours.
Sam Patel: Suggested employee hashtags: #MLInfra #LLMServes #RedwoodInference. Also three short comment templates in Drive to ease amplifier participation.
Zoe Martinez: Small note: add a pinned reply on X with the registration link + short bullets (3 takeaways). Ops, please pin after publish.
Eli Brooks: Will pin the reply. Also schedule a 30-minute huddle post-publish for engagement triage (ops + SDR).
Hiro Tanaka: Engagement playbook (short): triage first 3 hours, tag high-intent, collect top 10 replies for quote cards, SDR follow-up within 12h for APAC, 24h for NA.
Tara Singh: I'll hand the cleaned seedlists to SDR queue immediately after publish with mapping rules.
Sam Patel: Employee amp metrics: track shares, clicks per employee, and top performers. Will create a leaderboard in the amp sheet.
Zoe Martinez: Uploaded final creative + copy variants: https://drive.google.com/creative/novbench_uploads (files: hero_apac.png, slide_chart_v1.png, copy_longform.txt, copy_short_variants.txt)
amp-bot: Campaign created: novbench2025, analytics tag added.
Hiro Tanaka: Great work. Let's finalize copy & assets by 17:00 JST today. Leaving thread open for last-minute tweaks. :rocket:
